{{Quote|The world is almost uninhabitable, my lord. The loss of the hyper-point destablizer and its delivery vehicle has caused a thermal shift in the planet's atmosphere and tectonic instabilities that may yet tear Kromus apart. We are continuing to monitor the world as you instructed, but it is increasingly difficult to remain in orbit.|A report delivered to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] following the apparent destruction of the hyper-point destabilizer and the ''Shadowblade'' in the Kro'eval system|<ref name="Dark Soul" />}}
A '''hyper-point destablizer''' was a type of weapon. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''[[Shadowblade]]'', a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], was armed with a hyper-point destablizer.<ref name="Dark Soul" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one year after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Dark Soul]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the ''Shadowblade'' and its hyper-point destablizer were seemingly destroyed following an [[Battle of Kromus/Legends|attack]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on Separatist forces in the [[Kro'eval system]], where the ''Shadowblade'' was under construction.<ref name="Dark Soul" /> However, the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] secretly survived the battle and later [[Battle of Cularin/Legends|reappeared]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]<ref name="Last Stand">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20070201LastStand|text=Living Force: Last Stand|int=Living Force: Last Stand}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[Living Force: Last Stand]]'' is set shortly after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] but prior to the end of the Clone Wars, events that are dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''The New Essential Chronology''. As such it can be established that the events of the short story take place in 19 BBY.</ref> where it was drawn into a [[Time travel/Legends|temporal]] rift by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]]<ref name="Last Stand" /> and never seen again.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|274&ndash;275|Maelstrom}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The hyper-point destablizer was referenced in the [[2005]] short story ''[[Dark Soul]]'' by [[August Hahn|August]] and [[Cynthia Hahn]]. The short story provided no detail on the nature of the hyper-point destablizer other than noting it as the armament of the ''Shadowblade''. While the story described the ''Shadowblade'' as a superweapon, it did not clarify whether it was the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] hyper-point destablizer weapons specifically that resulted in the warship being classified as a superweapon.<ref name="Dark Soul" />
